system.description:
Grants the ability to instantly travel from one place to another.

  • Level 1: Teleport up to 10 meters
  • Level 2: Teleport up to 100 meters
  • Level 3: Teleport up to 1 kilometer
  • Level 4: Teleport up to 10 kilometers
  • Level 5: Teleport up to 100 kilometers
  • Level 6: Teleport up to 1,000 kilometers
